CA.rationale: No explicit attention/attention-allocation relation to contents found.

COD.rationale: Content (red/blue) and its organization/presentation (explicit position sets) and a separate origin/status field are all present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation condition linked to a content's presentation or access was stated.

C.rationale: Explicitly identifies content sets (red and blue) for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: The report separately records content (red set) and a distinct origin/status field for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Content is presented as organized spatial sets tied to a named referent/time, describing how the content is represented.
